scheduling: Decision, tracking/process and inference initially used two workers each on a four-CPU quota. Inference resumed from the same verified checkpoints at four workers after other pools exited. See development/inference_paper_scheduling.json.
timing_scope: Reported wall clocks include shared-host scheduling. CPU clocks are separate where available. Representative operation clocks, held-out generation-stage clocks and estimator clocks have different scopes; they do not establish universal complexity or dedicated latency.
